fightSong.title: Pour the Steel
fightSong.lyrics: Three rivers run, the furnaces glow / Pittsburgh steel, watch us go / Smelt it down, forge it true / Iron Smelters coming through!

stadium.name: The Furnace
stadium.tradition: The Pour — LED 'molten steel' flows down the scoreboard pre-game. If it reaches the bottom before kickoff, Smelters win 73% of the time. Fans chant the temperature.

fanCulture.description: They wear hard hats to games. After sacks, the crowd does the 'hammer swing.' Terrible Towels are now Terrible Welding Blankets. They work hard, they hit harder.
fanCulture.tailgate: Kielbasa, Iron City beer, and discussing the 1970s.

rivalries.name: The Rust Belt Classic
rivalries.narrative: Cleveland rocks, we smelt. It's been going since the mills closed.

rivalries.name: The Rust Belt Rumble
rivalries.narrative: They pick crabs, we pick quarterbacks off the turf.

cityFlavor: Bridges, hills, and hard work. We made the steel that built America, now we make linebackers.
